# [Mandatory] KBYG Berlin Exp Meetup
Date: 2026-10-08 | Duration: 22m

## Summary
The Berlin Experimentation Meetup is scheduled for October 15 from 18:30 to 22:00 at Zalando headquarters, with 100–150 attendees expected and the event effectively sold out. Success will be measured by connections with ideal customer profile prospects and meetings rather than lead scans, with a target of 25 high-value leads. The team will capture LinkedIn connections, record prospect details in HubSpot, and use Calendly to book meetings onsite. James will lead onsite logistics; the team arrives at 17:30, attendees at 18:00, and Zalando’s first talk starts at 18:30. Materials include a pop-up banner, postcards, T-shirts, stickers, and water bottles. Leftovers will be handled according to luggage space and prospect value. Final scheduling and shipment details remain pending from Marcel. After the event, contacts, companies, meetings, photos, video, and Hampus’s session should be documented. Expenses follow the existing process, with reports submitted to Jennifer within one week; hotels or Airbnb are acceptable within policy, understood as approximately 250 or less per night.

## Keywords
Berlin experimentation meetup, Zalando sponsorship, Event logistics, Calendly meeting booking, Lead tracking, Travel reimbursements
